scanNote:
Culture Clips 2-mavzusining ikkinchi beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 157.

Betda uchta matn bor: VANCOUVER, OTTAWA, MONTREAL.

Uchta surat:
• C — Ottavadagi Milliy galereya: shishali zamonaviy bino, oldida qizil, sariq va oq gulzorlar
• D — Monrealning eski qismidagi ko'cha kafesi: soyabonlar tagida stollar, odamlar o'tirgan, yonidan yo'lovchilar o'tyapti
• E — katta rangli surat: Monrealdagi Xitoy bog'ining pagodasi. Qayrilgan cherepitsali tomlar, qizil yog'och devorlar, eshik ustida xitoycha yozuvli yorliq

⚠ E surati Culture Clips bo'limining muqovasida (145-bet) ham ishlatilgan — bir xil surat.

O'ng pastda 'Speaking' — ikkita muhokama savoli.

⚠ Sariq bilan ta'kidlangan so'zlar (156-betdagi 4b mashqi uchun): clean, huge, beautiful, old, colourful.

⚠ Qalin harfli so'zlar (4a mashqining ikkinchi qismi uchun): ideal, attractions, sandy, totem poles, conference centre, mixture, cultural, spot, military parades, home, surrounded, treasured, popular, narrow, plants.

⚠ HALOL IZOH: Vancouver matnida 'It has a conference centre a luxury hotel' deb yozilgan — 'centre' dan keyin VERGUL TUShIB QOLGAN. To'g'risi: 'a conference centre, a luxury hotel, a huge cinema...'

⚠ HALOL IZOH: 'Indian totem poles' — eski atama. Hozirgi ingliz tilida 'First Nations' yoki 'Indigenous peoples' deyiladi.

⚠ FAKT TEKShIRUVI: kitobdagi ma'lumotlar to'g'ri — Ottava Kanada poytaxti; Milliy galereyada 25 000 dan ortiq asar bor; Monreal Botanika bog'i dunyodagi eng yiriklaridan; Monrealda aholining ko'pi fransuz tilida gapiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: TEXT 1 - VANCOUVER: Vancouver is one of the most beautiful places in Canada.
exercises.instructionUz: 1-MATN — VANKUVER: Vankuver — Kanadadagi eng go'zal joylardan biri.
exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI MATN — VANCOUVER.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'Vancouver is one of the most beautiful
   places in Canada. It has CLEAN streets
   and green parks and great views of the
   Pacific Ocean, to the west and HUGE
   mountains to the east. Vancouver is an
   IDEAL city. One of its main
   ATTRACTIONS is Stanley Park, where
   there are SANDY beaches, lakes, and
   even Indian TOTEM POLES. You must also
   visit Canada Place. It has a CONFERENCE
   CENTRE a luxury hotel, a huge cinema
   and there are special events held there
   all year round.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Vankuver — Kanadadagi eng go'zal
   joylardan biri. Uning toza ko'chalari,
   yashil bog'lari, g'arbda Tinch okeanining
   ajoyib manzarasi va sharqda ulkan tog'lari
   bor. Vankuver — ideal shahar. Uning
   asosiy diqqatga sazovor joylaridan biri —
   Stenli Park; u yerda qumli plyajlar,
   ko'llar va hatto totem ustunlari bor.
   Canada Place'ga ham borishingiz kerak.
   U yerda konferensiya markazi, hashamatli
   mehmonxona, ulkan kinoteatr bor va yil
   davomida maxsus tadbirlar o'tkaziladi.'


⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI — VERGUL TUShIB QOLGAN:

  Kitobda: 'It has a conference centre a
            luxury hotel, a huge cinema...'

  ⚠ 'centre' dan keyin VERGUL YO'Q.

  To'g'risi:
     'a conference centre, a luxury hotel,
      a huge cinema'

  ⚠ Ro'yxatda har bandidan keyin vergul
  qo'yiladi.


⚠⚠ 'ONE OF THE MOST BEAUTIFUL PLACES':

  ⚠ 'one of the' dan keyin KO'PLIK:
     'one of the most beautiful placeS' ✓
     'one of the most beautiful place'  ✗

  ⚠ 142-betdagi 'one of the biggest zoos'
  bilan bir xil qoida.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  ideal
     = ideal, mukammal
     ⚠ O'qilishi: [ay-DIL] — 'i' harfi
     'ay' deb o'qiladi!

  attractions
     = diqqatga sazovor joylar
     ⚠ 'to attract' (jalb qilmoq) dan
     yasalgan

  sandy
     = qumli
     ⚠ 'sand' (qum) + '-y'

  totem poles
     = totem ustunlari
     ⚠ 'a pole' = ustun, qoziq

  conference centre
     = konferensiya markazi
     ⚠ 'centre' — Britaniya imlosi
     (AmE: 'center')


⚠ 'MUST' — QAT'IY TAVSIYA:

  'You MUST also visit Canada Place.'
     = Albatta borishingiz kerak.

  ⚠ Sayohat matnlarida 'must' MAJBURIYAT
  emas, KUChLI TAVSIYA bildiradi.

  ⚠ 144-betdagi 'should' dan kuchliroq.


⚠ 'ALL YEAR ROUND':

  = yil davomida, butun yil bo'yi

  ⚠ 'round' bu yerda 'davomida' ma'nosida.


⚠ 'TO THE WEST' va 'IN THE WEST':

  'the Pacific Ocean, TO THE WEST'
     = g'arb TOMONDA (shahardan tashqarida)

  'Vancouver is IN THE west of Canada'
     = g'arb QISMIDA (ichida)

  ⚠ 'TO' — tashqarida; 'IN' — ichida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ideal        = ideal, mukammal
  an attraction = diqqatga sazovor joy
  to attract   = jalb qilmoq
  sandy        = qumli
  sand         = qum
  a pole       = ustun
  a conference centre = konferensiya markazi
  luxury       = hashamatli
  an event     = tadbir
  all year round = yil davomida
  a view       = manzara

points.en: Vancouver is one of the most beautiful places in Canada.
points.uz: Vankuver — Kanadadagi eng go'zal joylardan biri.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'ONE OF THE' + ORTTIRMA + KO'PLIK:
  'one of the most beautiful placeS'  ✓
  'one of the most beautiful place'   ✗

⚠ 'beautiful' uzun sifat → 'the MOST
beautiful'.

⚠ 142-betdagi 'one of the biggest zoos'
bilan bir xil qoida.

points.en: It has clean streets and green parks and great views of the Pacific Ocean, to the west and huge mountains to the east.
points.uz: Uning toza ko'chalari, yashil bog'lari, g'arbda Tinch okeanining ajoyib manzarasi va sharqda ulkan tog'lari bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'clean' va 'huge' — 4b mashqidagi
ta'kidlangan so'zlar (zid ma'nolari:
'dirty' va 'small').

⚠ 'TO the west' = g'arb TOMONDA
(shahardan tashqarida).
'IN the west' = g'arb QISMIDA (ichida).

⚠ 'a view OF' — 'of' bilan.

points.en: One of its main attractions is Stanley Park, where there are sandy beaches, lakes, and even Indian totem poles.
points.uz: Uning asosiy diqqatga sazovor joylaridan biri — Stenli Park; u yerda qumli plyajlar, ko'llar va hatto totem ustunlari bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'an attraction' = diqqatga sazovor joy
('to attract' — jalb qilmoq).

⚠ 'sandy' = 'sand' (qum) + '-y'.

⚠ 'where there are' — joyni tasvirlash
uchun ('where' + 'there is/are').

⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH: 'INDIAN totem poles' —
ESKI atama. Hozir 'First Nations' yoki
'Indigenous peoples' deyiladi.

points.en: You must also visit Canada Place.
points.uz: Canada Place'ga ham borishingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Sayohat matnlarida 'MUST' majburiyat
emas, KUCHLI TAVSIYA bildiradi.

⚠ Kuch darajasi:
  'You could visit...'  — mumkin
  'You should visit...' — kerak (maslahat)
  'You must visit...'   — ALBATTA kerak

points.en: It has a conference centre a luxury hotel, a huge cinema and there are special events held there all year round.
points.uz: U yerda konferensiya markazi, hashamatli mehmonxona, ulkan kinoteatr bor va yil davomida maxsus tadbirlar o'tkaziladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI: 'conference centre' dan
keyin VERGUL TUSHIB QOLGAN.

To'g'risi: 'a conference centre, a luxury
hotel, a huge cinema'.

⚠ Bu gap 156-betdagi 2-bandning javobi:
Canada Place PARK EMAS.

⚠ 'all year round' = yil davomida.

exercises.instructionEn: TEXT 2 - OTTAWA: Ottawa, the capital city of Canada, is a wonderful mixture of old and new buildings.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN — OTTAVA: Ottava, Kanadaning poytaxti, eski va yangi binolarning ajoyib uyg'unligi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKINChI MATN — OTTAWA.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'Ottawa, the capital city of Canada, is
   a wonderful MIXTURE of old and new
   buildings. This green city is a
   CULTURAL and historical centre for
   Canada. The people are friendly and
   speak both French and English.
   Parliament Hill is a popular tourist
   SPOT where visitors can watch MILITARY
   PARADES. Ottawa is also the HOME of
   Canada's National Gallery. It is
   SURROUNDED by BEAUTIFUL gardens.
   Inside, visitors can see over 25,000 of
   the world's most TREASURED works of
   art. With more than twenty-five other
   museums, sixty annual festivals and a
   wildlife park, Ottawa is a great city
   to visit.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Ottava, Kanadaning poytaxti, eski va
   yangi binolarning ajoyib uyg'unligi.
   Bu yashil shahar Kanadaning madaniy va
   tarixiy markazi. Odamlari mehribon, ham
   fransuz, ham ingliz tilida gapirishadi.
   Parlament tepaligi — sayyohlar sevadigan
   joy; u yerda harbiy paradlarni tomosha
   qilish mumkin. Ottava — Kanada Milliy
   galereyasining ham uyi. U go'zal bog'lar
   bilan o'ralgan. Ichkarida tashrif
   buyuruvchilar dunyoning eng qadrli 25 000
   dan ortiq san'at asarini ko'rishlari
   mumkin. Yigirma beshdan ortiq boshqa
   muzey, oltmishta yillik bayram va tabiat
   bog'i bilan Ottava — borishga arziydigan
   ajoyib shahar.'


⚠⚠ ENG NOZIK GAP (156-bet, 5-band):

  'With MORE THAN twenty-five other
   museums, SIXTY annual festivals and a
   wildlife park...'

  ⚠ 'more than' faqat MUZEYLARGA tegishli.
  ⚠ Bayramlar ANIQ oltmishta.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'over 60 festivals'
  gapi NOTO'G'RI (F).


⚠ VERGULLI IZOH:

  'Ottawa, THE CAPITAL CITY OF CANADA, is
   a wonderful mixture...'

  ⚠ Ikki vergul orasidagi qism — IZOH.
  ⚠ Ikkala vergul ham kerak.

  ⚠ 141-betdagi 'Mr Thomas, her teacher,
  gave...' bilan bir xil qolip.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  mixture
     = aralashma, uyg'unlik
     ⚠ 'to mix' (aralashtirmoq) +
     '-ture'

  cultural
     = madaniy
     ⚠ 'culture' (madaniyat) + '-al'

  spot
     = joy, nuqta
     ⚠ 'a tourist spot' = sayyohlar
     joyi
     ⚠ 'a spot' ning boshqa ma'nosi:
     dog', nuqta (kiyimdagi)

  military parades
     = harbiy paradlar

  home
     = uy; VATAN, MAKON
     ⚠ 'the home OF' = ... ning makoni
     (bu yerda 'uy' emas!)

  surrounded
     = o'ralgan
     ⚠ 'to surround' (o'rab olmoq)

  treasured
     = qadrli, e'zozlangan
     ⚠ 'a treasure' (xazina) dan


⚠ 'BOTH ... AND ...':

  'speak BOTH French AND English'
     = ham fransuz, ham ingliz tilida

  ⚠ Ikkalasini birga ta'kidlaydi.

  ⚠ Shu qatordagilar:
     both ... and ...   — ham, ham
     either ... or ...  — yo, yo
     neither ... nor ...— na, na


⚠ 'PEOPLE' — HAR DOIM KO'PLIK:

  'The people ARE friendly and SPEAK...'

  ⚠ 'people is' ✗
  ⚠ 'peoples' faqat XALQLAR ma'nosida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a mixture    = aralashma, uyg'unlik
  to mix       = aralashtirmoq
  cultural     = madaniy
  historical   = tarixiy
  a spot       = joy, nuqta
  a parade     = parad
  to surround  = o'rab olmoq
  a treasure   = xazina
  treasured    = qadrli
  a work of art = san'at asari
  annual       = yillik
  a wildlife park = tabiat bog'i
  a visitor    = tashrif buyuruvchi
  friendly     = mehribon

points.en: Ottawa, the capital city of Canada, is a wonderful mixture of old and new buildings.
points.uz: Ottava, Kanadaning poytaxti, eski va yangi binolarning ajoyib uyg'unligi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap 156-betdagi 1-bandning javobi:
poytaxt — OTTAWA, Vankuver EMAS.

⚠ VERGULLI IZOH: 'Ottawa, THE CAPITAL CITY
OF CANADA, is...' — ikkala vergul ham kerak.

⚠ 'a mixture' = 'to mix' + '-ture'.

⚠ 'old' va 'new' — 4b mashqidagi juft.

points.en: The people are friendly and speak both French and English.
points.uz: Odamlari mehribon, ham fransuz, ham ingliz tilida gapirishadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap 156-betdagi 4-bandning javobi (T).

⚠⚠ 'PEOPLE' HAR DOIM KO'PLIK:
  'The people ARE ... and SPEAK'  ✓
  'The people is ... speaks'      ✗

⚠ 'BOTH ... AND ...' = ham ..., ham ...
Ikkalasini birga ta'kidlaydi.

points.en: Parliament Hill is a popular tourist spot where visitors can watch military parades.
points.uz: Parlament tepaligi — sayyohlar sevadigan joy; u yerda harbiy paradlarni tomosha qilish mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ B suratdagi qizil kamzulli askarlar aynan
shu yerda.

⚠ 'a spot' = joy, nuqta.
'a tourist spot' = sayyohlar joyi.

⚠ 'to watch' = tomosha qilmoq (harakatni
kuzatib turish); 'to see' = ko'rmoq.

points.en: Ottawa is also the home of Canada's National Gallery. It is surrounded by beautiful gardens.
points.uz: Ottava — Kanada Milliy galereyasining ham uyi. U go'zal bog'lar bilan o'ralgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'the HOME OF' bu yerda 'uy' emas —
MAKON, joylashgan yer ma'nosida.

⚠ 'surrounded BY' — 'by' bilan
(majhul nisbat).

⚠ C suratdagi bino va gulzorlar aynan shu.

⚠ 'beautiful' — 4b mashqidagi so'z
(zid ma'nosi 'ugly').

points.en: Inside, visitors can see over 25,000 of the world's most treasured works of art.
points.uz: Ichkarida tashrif buyuruvchilar dunyoning eng qadrli 25 000 dan ortiq san'at asarini ko'rishlari mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'over 25,000' = 25 000 dan ORTIQ.

⚠ Ingliz tilida katta sonlarda VERGUL
ishlatiladi: 25,000 (25 ming).
O'zbek tilida bo'sh joy: 25 000.

⚠ 'treasured' = 'a treasure' (xazina) dan.

⚠ 'a work of art' = san'at asari;
ko'pligi 'workS of art'.

points.en: With more than twenty-five other museums, sixty annual festivals and a wildlife park, Ottawa is a great city to visit.
points.uz: Yigirma beshdan ortiq boshqa muzey, oltmishta yillik bayram va tabiat bog'i bilan Ottava — borishga arziydigan ajoyib shahar.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 156-betdagi 5-BANDNING JAVOBI SHU YERDA.

'MORE THAN twenty-five other museums,
SIXTY annual festivals'

⚠ 'more than' faqat MUZEYLARGA tegishli!
⚠ Bayramlar ANIQ oltmishta — 'over 60' EMAS.

⚠ Shuning uchun 5-band NOTO'G'RI (F).

⚠ 'annual' = yillik, har yilgi.

exercises.instructionEn: TEXT 3 - MONTREAL: The city of Montreal is sometimes called the Paris of North America.
exercises.instructionUz: 3-MATN — MONREAL: Monreal shahri ba'zan Shimoliy Amerikaning Parijchasi deb ataladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
UChINChI MATN — MONTREAL.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'The city of Montreal is sometimes
   called the Paris of North America. Two
   thirds of the people speak French. The
   area of Old Montreal is very POPULAR
   with tourists because of its NARROW
   streets, OLD buildings and
   European-style cafes and restaurants.
   In the Botanical Gardens there are over
   22,000 types of PLANTS and flowers from
   all over the world. The Chinese Garden
   is beautiful and it has a huge
   COLOURFUL pagoda.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Monreal shahri ba'zan Shimoliy
   Amerikaning Parijchasi deb ataladi.
   Aholining uchdan ikki qismi fransuz
   tilida gapiradi. Eski Monreal hududi
   sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur — uning
   tor ko'chalari, qadimiy binolari va
   Yevropa uslubidagi kafe-restoranlari
   tufayli. Botanika bog'ida dunyoning
   turli burchaklaridan keltirilgan 22 000
   dan ortiq turdagi o'simlik va gul bor.
   Xitoy bog'i go'zal va u yerda ulkan
   rang-barang pagoda bor.'


⚠⚠ 'TWO THIRDS' — KASR SONLAR:

  'TWO THIRDS of the people'
     = aholining UChDAN IKKI qismi

  ⚠ Kasr sonlar qanday o'qiladi:
     1/2  = a half
     1/3  = a third
     2/3  = two thirdS      ⚠ KO'PLIK!
     1/4  = a quarter
     3/4  = three quarterS  ⚠ KO'PLIK!

  ⚠ QOIDA: yuqoridagi son 1 dan katta
  bo'lsa, pastdagisi KO'PLIKDA:
     two thirdS, three quarterS


⚠ 'BECAUSE OF' + OT:

  'popular ... BECAUSE OF its narrow
   streets'

  ⚠ 'because OF' dan keyin OT keladi;
  ⚠ 'because' dan keyin GAP keladi:
     'because the streets are narrow'

  ⚠ 155-betdagi 'thanks to' bilan
  solishtiring: 'thanks to' — faqat
  YAXShI natija uchun.


⚠ 'IS CALLED' — MAJHUL NISBAT:

  'Montreal IS CALLED the Paris of North
   America.'
     = Monreal ... deb ATALADI.

  ⚠ 'is/are + 3-shakl' — ish kim tomonidan
  bajarilgani muhim emas.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  popular
     = mashhur, ommabop
     ⚠ 'popular WITH' — 'with' bilan!
     ('popular by' ✗)

  narrow
     = tor
     ⚠ zid ma'nosi: 'wide' (keng)

  plants
     = o'simliklar
     ⚠ 'a plant' ning boshqa ma'nosi:
     zavod, fabrika


⚠ 'EUROPEAN-STYLE' — QO'ShMA SIFAT:

  'European-style cafes'
     = Yevropa uslubidagi kafelar

  ⚠ Ot oldidan kelgan qo'shma sifat
  DEFIS bilan yoziladi.

  ⚠ 155-betdagi 'a 35-minute journey'
  bilan bir xil qoida.


⚠ 'AN EUROPEAN' EMAS, 'A EUROPEAN'!

  'European' 'yu-' tovushi bilan
  boshlanadi — UNDOSh kabi.

     'a European city'  ✓
     'an European city' ✗

  ⚠ Shu kabi: a university, a uniform.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  popular      = mashhur, ommabop
  narrow       = tor
  wide         = keng
  a plant      = o'simlik; zavod
  botanical    = botanika
  a type       = tur, xil
  an area      = hudud
  two thirds   = uchdan ikki
  because of   = ... tufayli
  European-style = Yevropa uslubidagi
  all over the world = butun dunyodan

points.en: The city of Montreal is sometimes called the Paris of North America.
points.uz: Monreal shahri ba'zan Shimoliy Amerikaning Parijchasi deb ataladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'IS CALLED' — MAJHUL NISBAT
('is/are' + 3-shakl).

Kim ataganini aytish shart emas.

⚠ Nega 'Parij'? Chunki fransuz tilida
gapirishadi, ko'chalari tor, binolari
qadimiy, kafelari Yevropa uslubida.

points.en: Two thirds of the people speak French.
points.uz: Aholining uchdan ikki qismi fransuz tilida gapiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ KASR SONLAR:
  1/2 = a half
  1/3 = a third
  2/3 = two thirdS   ⚠ KO'PLIK!
  3/4 = three quarterS

⚠ QOIDA: yuqoridagi son 1 dan katta bo'lsa,
pastdagisi KO'PLIKDA.

⚠ 'people' ko'plik → 'speak' ('speaks' ✗).

points.en: The area of Old Montreal is very popular with tourists because of its narrow streets and old buildings.
points.uz: Eski Monreal hududi sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur — tor ko'chalari va qadimiy binolari tufayli.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'popular WITH' — 'with' bilan!
('popular by' ✗)

⚠ 'BECAUSE OF' + OT;
'because' + GAP.

⚠ 'narrow' zid ma'nosi 'wide'.
⚠ 'old' — 4b mashqidagi so'z (zid ma'nosi
'new').

⚠ 'its' — egalik (apostrof YO'Q!).

points.en: ... and European-style cafes and restaurants.
points.uz: ... va Yevropa uslubidagi kafe-restoranlar.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'European-style' — DEFIS bilan yozilgan
qo'shma sifat (ot oldidan kelgani uchun).

⚠⚠ 'A European' — 'AN' EMAS!
'European' 'yu-' tovushi bilan boshlanadi,
u UNDOSH kabi.
  'a European city'  ✓

⚠ D suratdagi kafe aynan shu joyda.

points.en: In the Botanical Gardens there are over 22,000 types of plants and flowers from all over the world.
points.uz: Botanika bog'ida dunyoning turli burchaklaridan 22 000 dan ortiq turdagi o'simlik va gul bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'THERE ARE' — ko'plik.

⚠ 'a type OF' — 'of' bilan.

⚠ 'a plant' ikki ma'noda: o'simlik va
zavod/fabrika.

⚠ 'all over the world' = butun dunyodan.

⚠ Monreal Botanika bog'i — dunyodagi eng
yirik botanika bog'laridan biri.

points.en: The Chinese Garden is beautiful and it has a huge colourful pagoda.
points.uz: Xitoy bog'i go'zal va u yerda ulkan rang-barang pagoda bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap 156-betdagi 3-bandning javobi (T):
Xitoy bog'i MONREALDA.

⚠ 'colourful' — 4b mashqidagi so'z
(zid ma'nosi 'plain').

⚠ 'colour' — BRITANIYA imlosi
(AmE: 'color').

⚠ E suratdagi pagoda aynan shu. Bu surat
145-betdagi bo'lim muqovasida ham bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Speaking:  • Which of these cities would you like to visit, and why?  • Name three cities in your country. Which one is your favourite? What do you like about it? What can you see and do there?
exercises.instructionUz: Gapirish:  • Bu shaharlardan qaysi biriga borgingiz keladi va nega?  • Mamlakatingizdagi uchta shaharni ayting. Qaysi biri eng sevimlingiz? Unda nima yoqadi? U yerda nima ko'rish va nima qilish mumkin?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'SPEAKING' — GAPIRISh MAShQI.


BIRINChI SAVOL:
  'Which of these cities would you like to
   visit, and why?'

  ⚠⚠ 'WOULD LIKE TO' = xohlardim

     'I WOULD LIKE TO visit...'
     'I'D LIKE TO visit...'  (qisqartma)

  ⚠ 'would like' — 'want' dan MULOYIMROQ.

  ⚠ 'would like' dan keyin HAR DOIM 'TO':
     'I'd like TO visit'  ✓
     'I'd like visit'     ✗
     'I'd like visiting'  ✗

  ⚠ SOLIShTIRING: 'I LIKE visiting museums'
  (umuman yoqadi) — bu yerda '-ing'.

  NAMUNA JAVOB:
     'I would like to visit Vancouver
      because it has clean streets, huge
      mountains and sandy beaches. I love
      the sea, so Stanley Park is perfect
      for me.'


IKKINChI SAVOL:
  'Name three cities in your country.
   Which one is your favourite? What do
   you like about it? What can you see and
   do there?'

  ⚠ Bu — TO'RT qismli savol. Javob ham
  to'rt qismdan iborat bo'lsin.

  NAMUNA JAVOB (O'zbekiston haqida):

     'There are many beautiful cities in
      Uzbekistan. Three of them are
      Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva.

      My favourite is Samarkand. I like it
      because it is very old and it has
      wonderful blue buildings.

      In Samarkand you can see Registan
      Square, the Bibi-Khanym Mosque and
      the Gur-e-Amir. You can also walk
      in the old streets and buy souvenirs
      at the bazaar.'

  ⚠ 'Name' bu yerda FE'L: 'nomlang, ayting'.


⚠ 'FAVOURITE' — BRITANIYA IMLOSI:

     BrE: favourite  ('u' bilan)
     AmE: favorite

  ⚠ 'colour/color' bilan bir xil qoida.


⚠ MUHOKAMA UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  'I'd like to visit ... because ...'
  'My favourite city is ...'
  'What I like about it is ...'
  'You can see ... and you can do ...'
  'It is famous for ...'


⚠ 'FAMOUS FOR' — 'BY' EMAS:

  'Samarkand is FAMOUS FOR its
   architecture.'
     = Samarqand me'morchiligi bilan
       mashhur.

  ⚠ 'famous by' ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  would like to = ... qilishni xohlardim
  favourite    = sevimli
  to name      = nomlamoq, aytmoq
  famous for   = ... bilan mashhur
  a square     = maydon
  a mosque     = masjid
  a souvenir   = sovg'a, esdalik
  architecture = me'morchilik
